summary: Lerp-interpolates a base value between two prior float fields by factor a2, stores the base at this+0xA0, then writes three coefficient-scaled plus bias-adjusted outputs to this+0x94, this+0x98 and this+0x9C. Returns the float bits of the this+0x9C output. Per-frame physics state propagation with distance/time falloff.

local_names.v2: float* base = this + 37 (this+0x94 in units of float)
local_names.v3: lerped base value stored to this+0xA0

operations.description: v3 = (1.0 - a2) * v2[-30] + a2 * v2[-31], a linear interpolation between two prior float fields (indexes v2-31 and v2-30) by factor a2.
v2[3] = v3, storing the interpolated base at this+0xA0.
v6 = v3 * v2[-29] + v2[-37]; v7 = v3 * v2[-28] + v2[-36]; v8 = v3 * v2[-27] + v2[-35]; each output is the interpolated base scaled by a coefficient field plus a bias field.
*v2 = v6, writing the first output to this+0x94.
v2[1] = v7, writing the second output to this+0x98.
v2[2] = v8, writing the third output to this+0x9C.
Returns LODWORD(v8), the integer bit pattern of the float written to this+0x9C.

unresolved: All four outputs (0x94/0x98/0x9C/0xA0) are recalculated every frame, so external pokes do not persist.
